$comment: Neutral receiving contract derived independently from OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions 1.44 concepts.

deploymentEnvironment.description: Environment such as production, staging, or development.

failureType.description: Error classification associated with a failed request.

remoteEndpoint.description: Remote endpoint; logical server and directly connected peer can differ through proxies.

requestBodyBytes.description: Size of the request body in bytes.

responseBodyBytes.description: Size of the response body in bytes.

responseStatus.description: HTTP status code in the response.

retryCount.description: Ordinal number of a resent request.

serverHost.description: Host name or address of the HTTP server.

userAgent.description: User-agent string sent with the request.
